subject: POC: Stellar Commerce trial planning & risk tracking
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@stellarcommerce.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@stellarcommerce.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: POC: Stellar Commerce trial planning & risk tracking

Thanks for the time today — really appreciated the deep dive. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our side so we stay aligned heading into the trial: 

Summary of call:
- Goal: validate Redwood inference for real-time product recommendations (latency <= 120ms p95, throughput ~200rps) and evaluate embedding-based search for product catalog (~10M items).
- Primary success criteria (prelim): latency p95 < 120ms on your baseline traffic, embedding recall >= 92% for curated test set, end-to-end cost projection within your target TCO.
- Stakeholders: Emily (product), Carlos (engineering), Marissa (AM), David (solutions engineering), Dev (backend eng).

Proposed POC plan / timeline:
1) Week 0 (this week): finalize success criteria + share eval datasets and sample traffic.
2) Week 1: Redwood spins up trial environment (dedicated sandbox) + baseline perf run.
3) Week 2: Iteration on prompt/template and quantization profile; embedding index test.
4) Week 3: Final evaluation and decision meeting.

Owners:
- Redwood: Marissa (AM) — program lead, David (SE) — infra/setup, Dev — bug triage/engineering.
- Stellar: Emily — product owner, Carlos — infra/ops owner.

Attachments:
- I attached a draft success criteria workbook (POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx) and a short mapping doc for data flows (redwood-poc-mapping.pdf).

Next steps (for this week):
- Emily/Carlos: share the eval dataset and a sample traffic trace (anonymized) by EOD Thu 9/3.
- Redwood: confirm sandbox sizing and provide access steps by Fri 9/4.

If that looks right, I'll log the plan in HubSpot and create a shared doc for tracking risks/issues.
Thanks — Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Marissa — thank you for the clear recap. Quick confirmations from our side: 

- Success criteria: agree to the three buckets you listed. I'll add two product-level metrics for recall on personalized recommendations (NDCG@10 target) and a baseline error budget for any model hallucinations.
- Timeline: Week 0 dataset share will be tight but doable. We'll prioritize a 2-day anonymized traffic sample and the embedding seed set.

One ask from Legal: we'll need a short Data Processing Addendum for the trial (no customer PII will be shared, but legal wants doc for audit). Please loop your legal contact if you have a standard DPA.

I'll upload the dataset to the secure bucket by Thu 9/3 and ping you.

Cheers,

Quick update from engineering: we started a quick smoke test this morning against the sandbox provisioned earlier and hit a reproducible issue — some requests are failing with a 502 when we hit the embedding endpoint under burst load. Attached is a trimmed repro log (repro-logs-0903.txt).

We need to understand whether this is a config/timeout or a runtime memory pressure issue; it's blocking our ability to validate p95 under load. Can you triage?

Carlos
Senior Engineering Manager, Stellar Commerce

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@stellarcommerce.com>, Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@stellarcommerce.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: POC: blocking 502s on embedding endpoint — immediate triage requested

Folks — forwarding Carlos' repro. This is high priority for the trial timeline. Initial asks:
1) Dev/David: please triage and confirm whether this is an infra config (timeouts/NGINX) vs runtime (model KV cache / OOM).
2) Rishi: if this is a runtime regression, please advise on rollback or alternate model variant to keep the POC moving.
3) Carlos/Emily: we'll need a short mitigation plan + ETA by EOD today so Stellar can plan test reschedule.

I created a Jira ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8421 (INF-8421) — please update with root cause and status. Adding the repro file as an attachment to the ticket and HubSpot record.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@stellarcommerce.com>, Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@stellarcommerce.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC: blocking 502s on embedding endpoint — immediate triage requested

On Wed, Sep 3, 2026 at 11:45 AM, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@stellarcommerce.com> wrote:
> Quick update from engineering: we started a quick smoke test this morning against the sandbox provisioned earlier and hit a reproducible issue — some requests are failing with a 502 when we hit the embedding endpoint under burst load. Attached is a trimmed repro log (repro-logs-0903.txt).

Thanks for the repro, Carlos — we have triaged and have a plan: 

Findings so far:
- Initial signal looks like connection pool exhaustion between the routing proxy and worker pool under short burst patterns (not an OOM).
- Repro is consistent with our local stress test when limits are low (observed at <50 persistent connections).

Immediate mitigations (next 24 hours):
1) Increase proxy connection pool and worker thread cap for the sandbox (temporary, low-risk config change).
2) Apply a short-term QPS throttling rule to the embedding endpoint to smooth bursts while you run the test (we can make this invisible to tests by widening the window).
3) If needed, switch to the alternative model variant (quantized) that has a smaller memory footprint — Rishi to confirm safe variant.

ETA:
- Config change + throttling: 3 hours (target 16:30 PT today).
- Validation run and update back to Stellar: by 18:00 PT today.

I'll update INF-8421 with the change logs and add the repro file. Marissa — please confirm if we should go ahead with proxy pool bump and throttling.

--
Dev
Senior Software Engineer, Redwood Inference
